## Life Summary

Caroline Edna Lawrie was born on 21 April 1890 at Balaklava, South Australia, the eighth of nine children born to Robert Dunlop Lawrie and Caroline Hosking. She grew up on the family farm "Bleak Farm" at Long Plains, South Australia.

She married William Henry Parker and had at least three children: Shirley Edna Parker (who married Murray John Telfer), Sydney Hugh Parker, and William Humphrey Parker.

She died on 1 January 1957 at North Adelaide, South Australia.
